cli.help.locale: Operator display language for CLI help and console messages (en, de). Does not change audit, Windows Event Log, or syslog field names.
cli.help.install_service: Install as a Windows service (elevated) or a systemd unit on Linux (root).
cli.help.windows_service_account: Windows only (with --install-service): SCM logon. Omit for LocalSystem. Shortcuts: local-system, network-service, local-service; otherwise DOMAIN\User or .\User.
cli.help.windows_service_password: Windows only (with --install-service): service account password for sc.exe password=. Visible in the process command line; omit for LocalSystem / NT AUTHORITY or for gMSA / no-password accounts.
cli.help.uninstall_service: Remove the Windows service or Linux systemd unit installed by --install-service.
cli.help.start_service: Start the installed service (sc start / systemctl start).
cli.help.stop_service: Stop the installed service (sc stop / systemctl stop).
cli.help.config_dir: Sandbox settings root for lab / WSL smoke (routes AppConfig to {dir}/pim-offline-server/ instead of HKLM or /etc). Pass this flag explicitly; no process environment variables.
cli.cmd.run: Run the AIC Server daemon in the foreground (systemd / console).
cli.cmd.version: Print the package version (same payload as --version / -V).
cli.cmd.readiness_report: Emit an assessor-facing CMMC L2 enclave readiness report evaluated from the live server posture (no secrets).
cli.cmd.meter_usage: Gather a conservative, privacy-safe usage snapshot and dispatch it through the selected Marketplace metering provider (default: offline dry-run recorder).
cli.help.meter_dry_run: Force the offline dry-run recorder even if a cloud provider is selected.
cli.help.meter_plan_only: Print the plan and per-cloud readiness matrix, then exit without gathering a snapshot or dispatching.
cli.help.readiness_format: Output format: json (machine-readable) or md (Markdown checklist).
cli.msg.audit_english_only: Audit, Windows Event Log, and syslog payloads stay US English (stable field names and event IDs).
cli.msg.api_codes_english: API error codes stay English snake_case; the admin SPA maps codes to locale text.
